comment: Communities/districts along the V1 route (Airport → Ocho Rios). Wired to recognition-layer-2 community signs per GAME_SPEC. needs_owner_review:true entries have uncertain coordinates or route placement — owner's lived knowledge is authoritative.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The sand spit — sea on both sides, iconic coconut tree road from the airport.

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Roundabout gateway from the Palisadoes into Kingston.

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Industrial area on Windward Road just past the Harbour View roundabout.

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: Hillside community above Rockfort / Windward Road.

communities.name: Kingston
communities.note: Kingston — passing through the city heading toward Half Way Tree.

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Commercial hub of St. Andrew — the famous clock tower crossroads.

communities.name: Washington Gardens
communities.note: Residential area on the Spanish Town Road heading out of the city.

communities.name: Gregory Park
communities.note: Outskirts — Spanish Town Road corridor heading toward Caymanas.

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Town in the Rio Cobre gorge — Flat Bridge is just below.

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: St. Catherine market town — famous for the Linstead Market folk song.

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: St. Catherine town — bauxite mining area on the road to Moneague.

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: St. Ann junction town — crossroads between Kingston, Ocho Rios, and the interior.

communities.name: Cave Valley
communities.note: Small St. Ann community on the road between Moneague and Faith's Pen.

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Famous roadside cookshop strip — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival. A must-stop.

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Canopied gorge road through bamboo and tree ferns — old riverbed, totally unique.

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Tourism hub on the north coast — Dunn's River Falls is just west of town.
